meta.title: ERBA – European Regulatory Burden Alliance
meta.description: Europe's real economy has had enough. Join the movement measuring the real cost of cumulative EU regulation.
meta.joinDescription: Join as a company or a private individual. Adding a Pain Index figure is optional. Anonymous option available.
meta.loginDescription: Sign in to the ERBA member dashboard.
meta.painIndexTitle: The Pain Index – Documented Cost of EU Regulation
meta.painIndexDescription: Live, crowd-sourced total of annual compliance costs reported by European companies and private individuals, broken down by regulation. Each contribution is on a scale from €0 to €1 million.

footer.blurb: An independent coalition of companies and private individuals documenting the cumulative cost of EU regulation, one data point at a time.
footer.anonymousNote: Anonymous submissions are never attributed to a named company.

landing.badge: Open to companies and private individuals
landing.subhead: Cumulative EU regulations are killing competitiveness. Join the movement measuring the real cost.
landing.noFees: No fees. No lobbying budget required. Anonymous option available.
landing.whyNowTitle: The window to change course is closing.
landing.whyNowLead: Three forces converged in the last 18 months. Together they make the cost of silence higher than the cost of speaking up.
landing.farmerBody: Tractors blocked Brussels, Paris and Berlin. Farmers proved that when the real economy pushes back together, the Commission listens. Companies and private individuals have not yet made their voice heard at the same scale.
landing.greenBody: CSRD, CSDDD, EUDR, CBAM, the Taxonomy. Each rule alone is 'manageable'. Stacked together they consume entire finance and legal teams at companies that compete globally.
landing.mercosurBody: Trade deals open the door to competitors who face none of these obligations. Europe is exporting its industrial base while importing goods produced under lighter rules.
landing.howTitle: One number Brussels can't argue with.
landing.howLead: Anecdotes get dismissed. Aggregated, verifiable cost data from thousands of members does not. ERBA turns a compliance headache into a line item on the political agenda.
landing.step1Body: Join as a company or as a private individual. Two minutes. Anonymous if you prefer.
landing.step2Body: Pain Index figures are optional. If you add one, pick the regulation that hurts most and estimate the annual burden from €0 to €1 million.
landing.step3Body: Your data feeds the public Pain Index that policymakers can't ignore.
landing.closeTitle: Your compliance cost is a political fact.
landing.closeLead: Join {count} members already on the record. It takes less time than reading one CSRD disclosure requirement.

join.title: Join the Alliance.
join.lead: {count} members have already documented {cost} in regulatory burden. Companies and private individuals are welcome. Adding a Pain Index figure is optional.
join.twoMinBody: Three short steps. Pain Index is optional. No documents required.
join.anonBody: If you add a cost, it still counts; your name can stay hidden.
join.neverBody: Data is aggregated for advocacy only, never shared with vendors.

painIndex.title: The Pain Index
painIndex.lead: Total annual compliance cost documented by European companies and private individuals, regulation by regulation. Each contribution uses a €0 to €1 million scale.
painIndex.leaderboardTitle: Which regulation costs Europe the most?
painIndex.ranked: Ranked by total documented annual cost
painIndex.emptyBody: The Pain Index starts with the first member brave enough to put a number on it. Be the first data point — or join without one.
painIndex.method: Methodology: figures are self-reported annual compliance cost estimates from €0 to €1 million, submitted by member companies and private individuals. Identities are never displayed; anonymous submissions are included in aggregates. Totals refresh every minute.
painIndex.cta: Facing these costs — as a company or as a private individual?
painIndex.ctaAnon: Join free. Adding a Pain Index figure is optional, and you can stay anonymous.
painIndex.scaleHint: Each contribution is recorded on a scale from €0 to €1 million.
painIndex.scaleOverflow: Documented total is above the €1 million display scale.
